items.excerpt: SAG-AFTRA members will vote on a new TV animation agreement featuring annual wage increases, expanded AI protections for voice performers, better residuals and benefit gains.

items.title: LOFTAPPS to Debut LOFT Software and Peek at Phil Tippett's 'Mad God' Sequel at VIEW 2026

items.title: The Tools Shaping the Future of VFX

items.title: The Next Generation Speaks: What Young VFX Artists Are Doing Differently
items.excerpt: Gen Z VFX artists describe how they work differently, including how they separate efficiency-boosting traditional AI from generative AI and treat it as one tool inside the workflow.

items.title: Accounting for the New Economics of VFX
items.excerpt: Tax incentives, remote pipelines and AI efficiencies have reshaped how VFX work is bid, staffed and delivered; studios like Important Looking Pirates bet on generalist artists taking more ownership of shots with new AI tools.

items.title: The State of VFX and Animation Might Surprise You
items.excerpt: Three years after Jeffrey Katzenberg predicted AI would shrink a 500-artist animated feature crew to under 50 by 2026, Joseph Bell checks how AI has actually changed VFX and animation staffing.

items.title: Who owns 'brain rot'?: inside the international legal drama over a beloved meme
